findings.evidence: `rg` shows `theorem prod` only for `IsMaximalTotallyReal` at line 120; there is no `IsTotallyReal.prod` despite `IsTotallyReal` being introduced at lines 34-40.
findings.fix: Add `IsTotallyReal.prod` showing products of totally real submodules are totally real for `LinearMap.prodMap`.
findings.issue: `IsTotallyReal` has no product lemma, even though products are an operation in this file and `IsMaximalTotallyReal.prod` is public.

findings.evidence: Lines 210-213 define only `IsTotallyReal.image`; lines 221-235 provide both `IsMaximalTotallyReal.image` and `IsMaximalTotallyReal.image_iff`, with the needed `map_map_eq` helper private at line 204.
findings.fix: Add `IsTotallyReal.image_iff (hJ : J.comp J = -LinearMap.id) : IsTotallyReal J (L.map J) ↔ IsTotallyReal J L`, parallel to `IsMaximalTotallyReal.image_iff`.
findings.issue: The image API for `IsTotallyReal` only gives the forward direction under `J² = -1`, while the maximal predicate exposes the corresponding iff; downstream users cannot rewrite the converse without rebuilding the private `map_map_eq` argument.

summary: The old import path and stale doc issue are fixed, but the new `IsTotallyReal` predicate is missing parallel operation API that the existing maximal predicate exposes.
